additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0384635-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R3 170001456] Both Outlets unavailable CRM:00579001206
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Greetings of the day!
As mentioned in the previous mail,
currently there are no error flags regarding Outlet unavailable. The only error flag which we can see in the backend is ocppConnectionLost.
Both outlets seems to be available (Refer image below).
But we suspect that,
Customer is not able to see the Outlets available as charger is offline on OCPP. After resolving the OCPP issue, then outlets will be seen available in customer backend as well.
Hence, kindly plan a site intervention to check the Router (OCPP) connections and the Ethernet cable as well.
We recommend you to visit the site with spare router and LAN cable. And your laptop should have working Companion tool to configure router.
Also, customer mentioned that, the
Error LED on KF9 module was flashing. Kindly check the KF9 module also, if there is any issue with it.
Do let us know your observations after performing above steps to proceed further. We will wait for your feedback.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
